West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Principal Officers) Rules 1962
West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Principal Officers) Rules
1962
[Gazette of West
Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 24th April 1962]
No. SOI (LG).55-Mis/62. In exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (33) of subsection(1) of section 3, section 29 and section 121 of the
Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960 (X of 1960), read with the item 9 in
the Fourth Schedule thereto, the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make
the following rules, namely:
1. Short
title and commencement.-(1) These rules may
be called the West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Principal Officers) Rules,
1962.
(2) they
shall come into force at once.
2. Principal
Officer.-(1) The following officers of the Municipal Corporation of
Karachi and Lahore and of the Municipal Committees of the First Class by whatsoever
designation known, shall be the Principal Officers for the purposes of the
Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, and the rules framed thereunder:
(a) (i)
Chief Officer; and
(ii) Deputy Chief Officer.
(b) Engineer-in charge of the
Municipal Works Department.
(c) Medical Officer-in-charge of
the Municipal Health Department.
(d) (i)
Accounts Officer-in-charge of the Municipal Accounts Depart ment, and
(ii) Financial Advisor.
(e) (i) Taxation Officer-in charge of the Municipal
Taxation Department, and
(ii) Chief
Assessor and Collector.
(f) Education Officer-in-charge
of the Municipal Education Depart ment.
(g) Land Manager.
(h) Social Welfare
Officer-in-charge of the Municipal Social Welfare Department.
(2) The following officers of the
Municipal Committees of the Second Class by whatsoever designation known and
whether employed wholetime or part-time shall be the
Principal Officers for the purposes of the Municipal Administration Ordinance,
1960, and the rules framed thereunder:
(a) Chief Officer including the Secretary ;
(b) Engineer-in-charge of the
Municipal Works Department ; and
(c) Medical Officer-in-charge of
the Municipal Health Department
Provided that Government may vary
the list of Principal Officers, to which these rules apply, from time to time,
by notification in the Gazette :
Provided
further that nothing in these rules shall have the effect of altering the
existing terms and conditions, designation or emoluments of any of the officers
who are designated as Principal Officers under these rules.
3. Terms
and conditions of service. Notwithstanding
anything contained in the West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Business) Rules,
1960---
(a) Where a post of a Principal
Officer is included in the posts specified by Government under section 29 of
the Municipal Administration Ordinance, 1960, to be filled by persons belonging
to the Local Council's Service, the Controlling Authority shall appoint a
member of such service to the post on terms and conditions specified in the
rules regulating the Local Council's Service, provided that till such rules are
made, the Municipal Officers declared by these rules as Principal Officers
shall be entitled to the pay scales and be governed by the terms and conditions
of service applicable to them at present ; and
(b) Where a post of a Principal
Officer is not included in the posts to be filled by persons belonging to the
Local Council's Service, the Con-trolling Authority shall appoint a suitable
person to such post, on such terms and conditions as may be determined in each
case with the prior approval of the Government.
